title: Pick any shot from Higgsfield’s Community library, copy the exact prompt, and…
content:
Pick any shot from Higgsfield’s Community library, copy the exact prompt, and run it on Seedance 2.0 with the same model and generation settings to reproduce the result  
Use this style prompt: Avatar-scale fantasy jungle; hyper-realistic; no CGI gloss; no game-engine look  
Add this cinematography prompt: single continuous take; wide lens; GoPro-on-creature intimacy  
Add this lighting prompt: golden god-rays through canopy; rainbow through waterfall mist  
Add this action prompt: 15s soaring flight with butterflies, waterfall skim, razor-narrow gap, and a full world reveal
